name: For the Lion
community_notes: Used in the Command phase on one Vengeful Brethren unit

name: Mission Focus
community_notes: Used when a Vengeful Brethren unit within range of an objective is selected to attack in your Shooting phase or the Fight phase

name: Determined to the Last
community_notes: Bladeguard Veteran Squad targeted in the Fight phase before it has fought: each destroyed model stays on a 2+ and is removed once the unit has fought or at the end of the phase, whichever comes first

name: Wings of Shadow
community_notes: Used when an enemy unit targets a Ravenwing Fly unit in the opponent's Shooting phase

name: Skyborne Surveillance
community_notes: Used after a Ravenwing Fly unit has shot: visible enemy units within 6" of it have +3" detection range

name: We Are Vengeance
community_notes: Usable on an unengaged Ravenwing Fly unit that the enemy unit targeted

name: Knights of Iron
community_notes: One Ravenwing unit: models can move horizontally through terrain features during Normal, Advance and Charge moves this phase

name: Tactical Mastery
community_notes: A Ravenwing unit is additionally eligible to shoot and charge in a turn in which it Fell Back

name: Inescapable Justice
community_notes: Used just after your Oath of Moment target is destroyed: one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your Character becomes your Oath of Moment target

name: Relics of the Dark Age
community_notes: Infantry or Mounted unit not yet selected to shoot this phase

name: Lion's Will
community_notes: Used in the Command phase on an engaged unit; the +1 OC lasts until your next Command phase, the +1 to hit until the end of the turn

name: Duty Unto Death
community_notes: Deathwing unit targeted in the Fight phase: roll per destroyed model that has not fought, adding 1 if the unit is within range of your Vowed objective marker; on a 4+ the model fights after the attacking unit finishes, then is removed

name: Wrath of the Lion
community_notes: Deathwing Infantry unit after a Charge move: select one engaged enemy unit and roll one D6 per model, adding 1 if that enemy unit is within range of your Vowed objective marker - each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound (max 3)

name: Relic Teleportarium
community_notes: A Deathwing unit arriving by Deep Strike can be set up anywhere more than 6" horizontally from enemy models; it is then not eligible to declare a charge this turn

name: Champion of the Deathwing
community_notes: Deathwing model only; the 5+ Critical Hits apply while the bearer is within range of your Vowed objective marker

name: Singular Will
community_notes: Deathwing model only. Models in the bearer's unit move an additional 3" (6" total) when they Pile In or Consolidate

name: Supreme Combatant
community_notes: Vengeful Brethren Gravis Captain only; chosen when the unit is selected to attack

name: Dutiful Defenders
community_notes: Upgrade: Vengeful Brethren Bladeguard Veteran Squad only. Targeting this unit with Heroic Intervention costs 1 less CP (once per battle round)

name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
community_notes: Friendly Adeptus Astartes units within 6" of the bearer re-roll Battle-shock and Leadership tests

name: Ancient Weapons
community_notes: The bearer's melee weapons only

name: Deathwing Assault
community_notes: Deathwing model with Deep Strike only: the bearer's unit can arrive in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase regardless of mission rules

name: Lord of the Ravenwing
community_notes: Ravenwing model only

name: Thundercowl Turbines (Upgrade)
community_notes: Upgrade: Ravenwing Fly unit only. In your first Movement phase this unit can make an ingress move

name: Nightforged Battery (Upgrade)
community_notes: Upgrade: Land Speeder Vengeance unit only. Re-roll rolls that determine a weapon's number of Attacks, and Hazard rolls
